data.title: 雷姆 · 月光庭院
data.description: 【雷姆 · 月光庭院】月光皎洁的宅邸后花园里，盛开的蔷薇在微风中摇曳生姿。雷姆手持水壶细心地浇灌着花丛，在如水月色下回眸望向你，眼眸中盛满了毫无保留的深情与温柔——「无论前方的世界多么残酷……雷姆的心都会永远守在昴君的身边，做昴君专属的英雄女仆。」
data.promptProse: Among the mansion garden's blooming roses, Rem adjusts the flowers with a silver watering can nearby and looks back softly toward the viewer. Her elegant formal evening dress retains the special outing beneath blue hair and attentive eyes. The medium view places rose stems around her and the garden path behind. Cool moonlight illuminates dew and the can's curved metal, leaving overlapping leaf shadows around the blossoms and darker foliage farther away.
